title: New Approach to Detect and Isolate Rhamnogalacturonan-II in Arabidopsis thaliana Seed Mucilage
author: Dayan Sanhueza
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Seeds of Arabidopsis thaliana bxl1 (mutant) Reagents

steps.title: Make 0.5 M Na2CO3 solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.5 M sodium carbonate by adding 5.3 g Na2CO3 to 100 mL MilliQ water and mixing until dissolved.

steps.title: Make PyAW 1:10:200 (0.25% chlorobutanol)
steps.instruction: For 100 mL, combine 47 µL pyridine, 4.74 mL glacial acetic acid, 9.47 mL water, and 0.25 g chlorobutanol; mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Make PyAW 1:1:98 (0.25% chlorobutanol)
steps.instruction: For 1 L, combine 10 mL pyridine, 10 mL glacial acetic acid, 980 mL water, and 2.5 g chlorobutanol; mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Prepare Solution A (borax in sulfuric acid)
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 g sodium tetraborate decahydrate to 100 mL concentrated sulfuric acid and stir until dissolved.

steps.title: Prepare Solution B (NaOH and 3‑hydroxybiphenyl)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.4 g NaOH in 10 mL water, then add 0.015 g 3‑hydroxybiphenyl and mix.

steps.title: Prepare Galacturonic acid stock (0.1 mg/mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 mg D‑(+)-galacturonic acid monohydrate in 10 mL MilliQ water.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 M Tris‑HCl, pH 8.8
steps.instruction: Weigh 181.65 g Tris‑base, dissolve in 700 mL MilliQ water, add 31 mL HCl, adjust pH to 8.8 with 1 M HCl, and bring volume to 1 L with water.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % ammonium persulfate (APS)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g ammonium persulfate in 10 mL MilliQ water.

steps.title: Cast 26.4 % polyacrylamide gel (5 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 834 µL Tris‑HCl 1.5 M (pH 8.8), 3.33 mL 40 % acrylamide/bis‑acrylamide (29:1), 46.7 µL 10 % APS, 3.9 µL TEMED, and 834 µL water; polymerise between 0.75 mm spacers.

steps.title: Prepare 10× PAGE running buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 60.57 g Tris base and 28.53 g glycine in water and bring volume to 1 L.

steps.title: Prepare loading buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.53 g Tris in 7 mL water, adjust pH to 6.8 with 1 M HCl, make up to 10 mL, add 0.05 g bromophenol blue and 10 mL glycerol; final volume 20 mL.

steps.title: Prepare fixing solution
steps.instruction: Mix 400 mL ethanol, 100 mL glacial acetic acid, and 500 mL water (total 1 L).

steps.title: Prepare 400 µM sodium thiosulfate
steps.instruction: Dissolve 63.2 mg sodium thiosulfate in 1 L water.

steps.title: Prepare 6 mM AgNO3 / 10 mM formaldehyde (fresh)
steps.instruction: Add 0.102 g silver nitrate and 75.2 µL 37 % formaldehyde to 100 mL water; prepare immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare developing solution
steps.instruction: Add 29.68 g sodium carbonate, 20 mL of the 400 µM thiosulfate solution (Recipe 13), and 4.8 mL 37 % formaldehyde to 975.2 mL water; mix.

steps.title: Prepare stopping solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 40 g Tris in 980 mL water, then add 20 mL glacial acetic acid and bring volume to 1 L.

steps.title: Weigh and incubate seeds for mucilage extraction
steps.instruction: Weigh ~50 mg dry Arabidopsis seeds, add 4 mL MilliQ water, and incubate with agitation for 2 h.

steps.title: Centrifuge and boil supernatant, freeze‑store
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3,500 × g for 5 min, collect supernatant, boil at 100 °C for 5 min, then store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Freeze‑dry and resuspend mucilage in Na2CO3
steps.instruction: Freeze‑dry the boiled supernatant, resuspend the dried mucilage in 500 µL 0.5 M Na2CO3, and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Neutralise Na2CO3 with glacial acetic acid
steps.instruction: Add ~50 µL glacial acetic acid to the suspension, watching for cessation of fizzing (CO₂ evolution).

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of mucilage
steps.instruction: Add 1.1 mL absolute ethanol (two volumes) to the neutralised suspension, mix, and centrifuge at 3,500 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Rinse pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Vortex the pellet with 80 % ethanol twice, then vortex with absolute ethanol once.

steps.title: Digest mucilage with endo‑polygalacturonase in PyAW
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 2 mL PyAW 1:10:200 (0.25 % chlorobutanol), add 1.1 U endo‑polygalacturonase, and incubate overnight at 25 °C with agitation.

steps.title: Centrifuge digested sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3,500 × g for 5 min and retain the supernatant.

steps.title: Load supernatant onto Bio‑Gel P‑30 column
steps.instruction: Apply the entire 2 mL supernatant to a Bio‑Gel P‑30 column (2.5 × 57 cm) set at 1 mL min⁻¹ flow rate.

steps.title: Elute column and collect fractions
steps.instruction: Elute with PyAW 1:1:98 (0.25 % chlorobutanol), discard the first 10 mL, then collect 60 fractions of 5 mL each.

steps.title: Uronic acid assay for fractions
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL fraction to 100 µL Solution A, vortex, incubate at 100 °C for 5 min, transfer 120 µL to a 96‑well plate, measure absorbance at 520 nm, add 2 µL Solution B, mix, and measure absorbance again at 520 nm.

steps.title: Prepare GalA calibration series
steps.instruction: Using the 0.1 mg/mL GalA stock, prepare 80 µL of each standard (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 µg) by mixing the appropriate volumes of stock and MilliQ water as listed in Table 1.

steps.title: Run calibration assay (repeat uronic assay)
steps.instruction: Perform the uronic acid assay (steps B1‑B7) on each GalA standard; run three replicates per concentration.

steps.title: Pool RG‑II fractions and speed‑vac dry
steps.instruction: Combine fractions 21–29, place in a speed‑vac, and dry at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend pooled sample and re‑quantify
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pool in 200 µL MilliQ water, repeat the uronic acid assay (steps B1‑B7) to determine GalA concentration, and prepare a 0.1 µg µL⁻¹ RG‑II solution.

steps.title: Mix sample with loading buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 8 µL of the 0.1 µg µL⁻¹ RG‑II solution with 2 µL loading buffer; keep on ice until loading.

steps.title: Cast PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Prepare the 26.4 % polyacrylamide gel as described in step 9 and allow it to polymerise.

steps.title: Load sample onto gel
steps.instruction: Load the 10 µL mixture (sample + loading buffer) into a well of the cast gel.

steps.title: Run gel at 200 V
steps.instruction: Run the PAGE gel at 200 V for 75 min.

steps.title: Fix gel 30 min
steps.instruction: Incubate the gel in fixing solution for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash gel three times 1 min
steps.instruction: Rinse the gel three times with MilliQ water, 1 min each wash.

steps.title: Incubate gel in thiosulfate 1 min
steps.instruction: Place the gel in 400 µM sodium thiosulfate solution for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash gel three times 1 min
steps.instruction: Rinse the gel three times with MilliQ water, 1 min each wash.

steps.title: Incubate gel in silver nitrate/formaldehyde 20 min
steps.instruction: Treat the gel with the freshly prepared 6 mM silver nitrate / 10 mM formaldehyde solution for 20 min.

steps.title: Wash gel twice 20 s
steps.instruction: Rinse the gel twice with MilliQ water, 20 seconds each.

steps.title: Develop gel until bands visible
steps.instruction: Incubate the gel in developing solution for 2–10 min, monitoring until bands appear.

steps.title: Stop development with stopping solution
steps.instruction: Add stopping solution to the gel to halt the silver staining reaction.
